chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 491: The Transformed Treasure Unleashes Chaos Among Nascent Soul Cultivators
chapter_meta_description: A transformed treasure escapes the Void Heaven Cauldron, triggering a full-scale scramble among Nascent Soul old monsters. Han Li watches and calculates.
og_title: The Treasure Hunt Turns Deadly in A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 491
og_description: The Void Heaven Cauldron spits out a transformed treasure, and the Nascent Soul cultivators stop sparring and start fighting for real.
twitter_title: Void Heaven Cauldron erupts—transformed treasure changes everything.
twitter_description: Nascent Soul old monsters drop the act. The treasure is real. The scramble is on.

lore_anchors.definition: A magical treasure that has taken on a living form, capable of independent action and self-defense. Far rarer and more powerful than ordinary artifacts.
The fourth major cultivation stage, where a cultivator gives birth to a Nascent Soul, granting immense power, extended lifespan, and the ability to survive bodily destruction.
The supreme treasure sealed in the innermost chamber of the Void Heaven Palace; the primary objective of the expedition.
A hedonistic, mid-level demonic overlord of the Chaotic Star Sea; known for his raw power and the Heavenly Devil Arts.
The Sect Leader of the Ten Thousand Laws Sect; a cold, calculating righteous-path leader who masks lethal intent behind a casual demeanor.
The founder of Extreme Yin Island, a demonic Nascent Soul cultivator known for his protective nature and ruthless methods.
A thousand-year-old ghost who sacrificed his physical form for vengeance; exists as a Profound Soul Body and speaks with dry, weary authority.
A demonic cultivator and disciple of Extreme Yin Island, known for his arrogance and lecherous demeanor.
